question: In which of the following years was Pro Kabaddi League established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) was established in India in the year **2014**.
 
• It was inspired by the popularity of the Kabaddi tournament at the 2006 Asian Games.
 
• PKL is based on the format of the Indian Premier League (IPL) for cricket.
 
• It was launched by Mashal Sports, with Charu Sharma and Anand Mahindra being the key figures behind its inception.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pro Kabaddi League (PKL)**

 
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League is a professional-level Kabaddi league in India, which started in 2014.
 
• The league follows a round-robin format followed by playoffs and a final to determine the winner.
 
• PKL has significantly contributed to the resurgence and popularity of Kabaddi in India.
 
• It features players from India and abroad, showcasing the sport's international appeal.
 
 
 
• **Kabaddi**
 
 
• Kabaddi is a contact team sport that originated in ancient India.
 
• The game involves two teams, each occupying opposite halves of a field, and taking turns sending a "raider" into the other half to tag and return to their half without being tackled.
 
• The sport is popular in South Asia and is the national game of Bangladesh.
 
• Kabaddi is also played professionally in the Pro Kabaddi League in India and various other leagues around the world.
 
 
 
• **Indian Premier League (IPL)**
 
 
• The Indian Premier League is a professional Twenty20 cricket league in India contested during March or April and May of every year by teams representing Indian cities.
 
• The league was founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in 2008.
 
• It is the most-attended cricket league in the world and ranks sixth among all sports leagues.
 
• The IPL has helped popularize the T20 format and has provided a platform for many young cricketers to showcase their talent.
 
 
 
• **Mashal Sports**
 
 
• Mashal Sports is a sports management company based in India.
 
• The company was founded by sports commentator Charu Sharma and industrialist Anand Mahindra.
 
• Mashal Sports is known for organizing the Pro Kabaddi League, which has become a prominent sports league in India.
 
• The company aims to elevate the status of Kabaddi and other sports in India through professional leagues and events.
